title: Explore and Create — Art and Science Quiz
description: Test your knowledge of the hands-on science experiments and art projects and what they taught us about God's creation!

questions.question: What happens when you mix baking soda and vinegar in a volcano model?
questions.explanation: When baking soda and vinegar mix, they create a chemical reaction that produces a fizzy eruption, like lava flowing from a volcano.

questions.question: What is the process called when a caterpillar changes into a butterfly?
questions.explanation: Metamorphosis is the process where a caterpillar completely transforms through four stages — egg, caterpillar, chrysalis, and butterfly — by God's amazing design.

questions.question: On which day of Creation did God make the stars?
questions.explanation: God created the sun, moon, and stars on Day 4 of Creation to govern day and night and to mark seasons (Genesis 1:14-19).

questions.question: What are the three main types of rocks?
questions.explanation: God created three main types of rocks: igneous (from cooled lava), sedimentary (from layers pressed together), and metamorphic (changed by heat and pressure).

questions.question: What does a wind vane measure?
options: Which direction the wind comes from
questions.explanation: A wind vane shows which direction the wind is coming from. It points into the wind so you can tell if it blows from the north, south, east, or west.

questions.question: What is a terrarium?
options: A mini garden inside a container
questions.explanation: A terrarium is like a tiny garden inside a jar or container. It has soil, plants, and water that work together in a mini ecosystem designed by God.

questions.question: Why does the Bible call God our 'Rock'?
options: Because God is made of stone
Because God is strong, solid, and dependable
questions.explanation: The Bible calls God our 'Rock' because He is strong, solid, and dependable — just like a big, sturdy rock that never moves (Psalm 18:2).

questions.question: What does 2 Corinthians 5:17 say about being in Christ?
questions.explanation: 2 Corinthians 5:17 says that if anyone is in Christ, the new creation has come — the old has gone and the new is here! Just like a caterpillar becomes a butterfly, God makes us new.
